groups.narration:
On 2026-08-15, the files `frontend/.env.development` and `frontend/.env.production` were committed with the message “Configure frontend API URLs for development and production.” Both files remain in the repository’s history.

The commit message indicates an intention to configure API URLs, but the committed files themselves contained whatever data existed at the time of the commit. The files were not subsequently removed from the working tree.

The initial commit on 2026-07-30 included a database URL with credentials in `database.py` on line 7 and in `docker-compose.yml` on line 20, as well as a database password in `docker-compose.yml` on line 9. These credential-shaped values were removed from the current working tree, but remain in the commit history. The commit message for this initial commit was “Initial commit”.

The database URL and password are present in the repository’s history, specifically in the initial commit. These values are still accessible to anyone with access to the repository’s history.
